primary_estimand: incremental qualifying F9 appointments per route-day under assigned policy
secondary_estimands: net expected commercial value per route-day
travel and labour cost per route-day

phases.purpose: debug logging, adherence, feasibility and label workflow; not powered for lift
estimate base rates and variance under incumbent/random/stratified alternatives
power from observed baseline and target minimum detectable effect
compare policies without changing assigned visits
limited operational deployment after causal and security gates

analysis: cluster-robust or randomization-based uncertainty at route-day level
doubly robust adjustment only with prespecified covariates
report absolute lift, relative lift and confidence intervals
separate prediction, route optimization and representative adherence effects
do not stop early for point-estimate excitement
stopping_rules: stop for safety, compliance, protected-account or data-integrity breach
stop or redesign when adherence makes treatment contrast non-identifiable
reject or retire when confidence bounds exclude minimum practical value
continue when uncertainty remains and expected information value is positive
